possible_values: Continuous monetary value -- CONFIRMED deterministic function of VAL_TOT (see guidance).
grouping_guidance: RESOLVED via full 12-month ratio check: within any given month, VAL_TOT/US_TOT is IDENTICAL for every single record in that month (e.g. exactly 4.95 for every Jan row, 4.99 for every Feb row), though the ratio itself drifts across months (4.95 to 6.20 over the year). This is a deterministic transformation, not a correlation -- US_TOT = VAL_TOT x that month's fixed conversion factor (almost certainly the monthly official BRL/USD rate). CONCLUSION: US_TOT carries zero independent information beyond VAL_TOT + month. Safe to drop entirely from analysis -- keep VAL_TOT as the sole cost measure.
source: Project full-year ratio check (this session, all 12 months confirmed) -- no official documentation addressed this relationship
